_doc: Crops added for US, UK and EU farming. Same schema as crop_knowledge.json. price_q is INR/quintal for the India fallback; regional prices live in regions.json. bu_kg = kilograms per bushel for US display.

tips.sowing: Autumn or early spring at 20 kg/ha into a fine, firm seedbed; inoculate with Sinorhizobium.
tips.irrigation: Deep-rooted but high water use: irrigate after each cut, never before.
tips.fertilizer: Fixes its own nitrogen; potash and phosphorus replace what each cut removes.
tips.pests: Alfalfa weevil and aphids; cut early rather than spray when thresholds are hit.
tips.harvest: Cut at early bud for quality, 25-35 day intervals, 4-8 cuts a year depending on climate.

tips.sowing: Spring oats as soon as the soil is workable; winter oats in October at 350 seeds/m2.
tips.irrigation: Rarely irrigated; sensitive to drought at panicle emergence.
tips.fertilizer: Moderate nitrogen; excess lodges the crop badly.
tips.pests: Crown rust, frit fly in late sowings.
tips.harvest: Harvest at 14% moisture when panicles are fully yellow.

tips.sowing: Late September to October; the hardiest cereal, fine on light acid soils.
tips.fertilizer: Split nitrogen at tillering and stem extension.
tips.pests: Ergot: clean seed, mow field margins before flowering.
tips.harvest: Harvest promptly at ripeness; rye sprouts in the ear in wet Augusts.

tips.sowing: Winter rape late August to mid September at 40-60 seeds/m2; spring rape in April.
tips.irrigation: Rarely; flowering and pod fill are the sensitive stages.
tips.fertilizer: High nitrogen and sulphur demand; 30-50 kg/ha SO3.
tips.pests: Cabbage stem flea beetle at emergence, pollen beetle at green bud; threshold-based sprays only.
tips.harvest: Direct combine when seed is black and rattles in the pod, about 9% moisture.

tips.sowing: After the last frost when soil is above 15 C, 75 cm rows.
tips.irrigation: Critical at flowering and pod fill; avoid wetting foliage.
tips.pests: White mould in dense wet canopies; bacterial blight from splashed rain.
tips.harvest: Undercut and windrow at 30-40% moisture, thresh when dry.

tips.sowing: Drill to a stand of 100,000 plants/ha as early as March when soil is above 5 C.
tips.irrigation: Responds to irrigation in July-August on light soils.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen modest: excess lowers sugar content. Sodium and boron often needed.
tips.pests: Virus yellows via aphids; beet moth in hot summers.
tips.harvest: Lift from late September; sugar rises with cool nights.

tips.sowing: Winter beans October-November at 20 seeds/m2 on heavy land; spring beans February-March at 45 seeds/m2.
tips.irrigation: Rarely; flowering drought halves yield on light soils.
tips.fertilizer: No nitrogen; phosphorus and potash to index.
tips.pests: Chocolate spot in wet springs, bruchid beetle at pod set, black bean aphid.
tips.harvest: Combine when pods are black and dry, about 18% moisture.

tips.sowing: Reseed in April or August at 30-35 kg/ha; roll after sowing.
tips.irrigation: Rain-fed in maritime climates; growth stalls under 5 C.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen after every cut or grazing, 40-60 kg/ha, plus slurry.
tips.pests: Leatherjackets and frit fly in new leys.
tips.harvest: First silage cut mid May at heading for energy, then every 5-6 weeks.

tips.sowing: Successive sowings every 2 weeks after soil reaches 15 C; isolate from field corn.
tips.irrigation: Never let it dry at silking; drip or furrow every 4-6 days.
tips.fertilizer: Nitrogen split at planting, knee-high and tasseling.
tips.pests: Corn earworm: pheromone traps and Bt or spinosad at silking.
tips.harvest: Pick at milk stage, 18-22 days after silking, and cool immediately.
